name: kinemax
description: Kinemax: a fictional premium multi-location cinema website (personal portfolio project).

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors red,white --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @kinemax/api" "npm run dev -w @kinemax/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kinemax/shared && npm run build -w @kinemax/api && npm run build -w @kinemax/web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e:run
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:cov && npm run build && npm run e2e:run && npm run audit
